eattheday.text: EatTheDay waits, then strikes: matchup rating and resistance both among the very best, with a matchup K/D line that matches. The bravery number is near the bottom, the headshot share nearly absent, which fits a player who lets the fight come to them instead of chasing it. The lifetime board paints a far humbler picture, with the lifetime IvI near the very bottom while the matchups sit at the top.

evasiva.text: Evasiva plays the complete game: matchup rating, pace, and bravery all at the top, with resistance that refuses to bend against the hardest attacks. Headshots sit mid-pack, so body shots carry the load — and carry it well, with accuracy near the top. Consistency lands mid-pack too, the lone wrinkle in an otherwise flawless card. A polished, versatile fighter with no real hole to poke.

emeraldtester2432.text: emeraldtester2432 plays a measured, stubborn game: rating and resistance in the upper tier, tempo and bravery just behind, with the matchup kill-death mark holding its ground. Accuracy and headshot share sit mid-pack, yet the results stay elite — the edge comes from judgment, not raw aim. The lifetime IvI sits mid-pack too, so the matchups tell the stronger story.

eyfia.text: Eyfia wastes no motion: the matchup rating runs near the top, the tempo sits just as high, and the game keeps rising as the enemies get tougher. Accuracy runs well above average and headshots land there too, the kill rate runs above average, and the lifetime ledger sits in the same strong bracket. A sharp, efficient presence that keeps delivering.

elelnos.text: ELElNOS plays a polished, high-tempo game with output sitting near the top; a game that rises as enemies improve. Accuracy lands among the elite few, with the matchup rating sitting near the top, the lifetime board confirming that verdict, and consistency above average too, so the card keeps its edge against the strongest third.

eggbreakerr.text: Eggbreakerr wastes nothing: rating near the top, activity close behind, bravery and resistance near the top, kills coming at a top rate. The aim is sharp, headshots land near the top, with lifetime numbers landing near the top as well. The matchup kill-death mark sits a notch below the rest, the only modest line on a strong card.

empha.text: Empha is a young account already playing near the top: matchup rating, bravery, resistance, and kill-death all in the top ranks, with pace above average. Shots land clean and headshots plentiful, while consistency sits mid-pack — the one line still catching up. The lifetime record has them above average, a step below the matchups, and the start already speaks volumes.

effectns.text: EffectNS is a precision instrument: a high-tempo engine, nerve to match, and elite resistance, with accuracy among the best tracked and a lifetime board right there too. The kills arrive at a top rate, and the headshots follow. The consistency mark falls below average, the lone blemish on an otherwise flawless card.

exonc.text: exonc has played since 2016 with a sharp, resilient edge: resistance and matchup kill-death near the top, bravery and activity well above average. The consistency mark sits near the bottom, so the game fades hard against the strongest third. Still, the accuracy stays well above average and the lifetime numbers sit above average, enough for a top-tier record.

eurowinna.text: EUROWINNA plays a sharp, high-volume game: activity and bravery near the very top, with accuracy and headshots both near the top. The lifetime board rates them among the very best tracked, and the consistency mark sits near the top as well. A complete game with every line reading strong.

ezzzzzzzzzzzzzzztrw.text: ezzzzzzzzzzzzzzztrw has barely arrived and already plays like a fixture: rating, activity, resistance, and matchup kill-death all sit near the very top. The game holds only middling ground as the opposition improves, and the consistency mark dips below average, so the shape still has rough edges. Early read on a young account, but the opening pages already carry real weight.

ericfreeman1.text: Ericfreeman1 has been at this since 2015, and it shows in the steadiness: a top-shelf rating, a head-to-head ledger near the very best, and resistance that barely bends against stronger opposition. The lifetime board sits just below the matchups, and the edge narrows a touch against the hardest third. A veteran built on patience and timing.

erendil.text: Since 2012, Erendil has made a career out of winning the fights that count: upper tier across the matchup board, a head-to-head kill-death line near the top, and resistance that gives little away. The pace is unhurried and the aim ordinary, yet the results keep landing high. The lifetime board tells a plainer tale, middling where the matchups read strong.

eu460vs.text: EU460VS plays a game built on pressure: upper-tier matchup rating, tempo near the top, and resistance that barely bends. The duel kill-death line sits just under the summit, and the lifetime ledger agrees with the matchups. The one soft seam in an otherwise strong card: the edge thins against the hardest third.
